notes.title: 2024/09/30 Update: NEW Chinese Support Added!
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE NOTES[/b]
[list][*]New Simplified and Traditional Chinese translations are now available. To access them, please switch your game language via the Steam library.[/list]

[b]HOW TO SWITCH LANGUAGES[/b]
1. Right-click the game in your Steam Library.
2. Select "Properties" in the drop-down menu that appears.
3. In the "General" tab, select the "Language" of your choice from the drop-down menu. The available options should be "English", "Simplified Chinese", and "Traditional Chinese".
4. After you switch the game's language, the game will automatically update to your new preference.

* [i]Please note that save data compatibility is not guaranteed between versions. Switching languages is known to cause temporary font display issues immediately after loading a save from another language.[/i]

notes.title: Eden's Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy Available Now!
notes.content:
[i]Eden’s Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy[/i], an adults-only, dark and dirty fantasy visual novel developed by Waffle and localized by ShiraVN, is now available on Steam!
Follow Princess Cecily and her lady knight Noein through their desperate struggle to protect their holy kingdom from lecherous demons—no matter the physical cost to themselves.

[h3]Contents[/h3]
[i]Eden's Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy[/i] contains both the first story set in the world of [i]Eden's Ritter[/i] and two additional side stories.
[list]
[*]The [i]main story[/i] follows Cecily and Noein's quest to save their kingdom from a creeping evil whose tentacles lurk in every corner. Will these angelic women fall or win through?
[*]In the [i]Xenoarachne Defeat[/i] story, the heroines are caught like flies in the web of one of their most dangerous enemies. Her soft and silken threads draw them in ever closer, until the former heroines find themselves dancing on her strings...
[*]In the [i]Doppelganger Defeat[/i] story, the heroines fall prey to Dark Nephilim, a creature as twisted as she is cruel. Entrapped in a world of dreams, the bond between the two is warped and exploited, their flaws turned against them to a bitter end...[/list]
[h3]Pricing[/h3]
The game is priced at $29.99 USD, with regional pricing enabled for other countries. It's also launching with a 15% discount for the first week—don't miss it!

[h3]Story[/h3]
The kingdom of Ellerald, where stretch the roots of sacred Sephirot, is under attack by monsters that ravage the land and its people. The royal priestess Cecily sustains the hearts of the populace through her kindness and piety, while the well-endowed warrior Noein and her soldiers keep the beasts at bay.
The enemy Lustfiends seem as dumb as they are vile, so their pincer assault comes as a shock. When the city’s remaining defenses prove too meager, only Princess Cecily can save the kingdom... but how can this sheltered damsel fend off nightmarish waves of sex-craved creatures when she can’t lift a sword to save her life?
Cecily harnesses the power of Eden to becoming the titular (and titillating) divine warrior, Eden’s Ritter Lucifel! With powerful forbidden magics, she becomes a one-woman army—a guardian angel to her people.
But these powers come at a cost, for the longer she uses them, the more unbearable the aching of her body becomes. Each battle is a race against the clock, pushing Cecily to her limits as she strives to overcome her adversaries before her own sexual urges overcome her! It’s up to you to help Cecily make the right choices in battle and lead her to victory, for should she fail to do so, her enemies will take advantage of her compromised state to bring her journey to a bad ending.

Boasting an engaging, erotic narrative and two extra side stories, Eden’s Ritter: Paladins of Ecstasy is available now!
